messages:
sanjay: Following up on last night's postmortem — need to consolidate alert tuning action items for the recurring 503 spikes. Short version: noisy replica-fail alerts + long-tail request latency are causing most pages.

maya: I sketched a dedupe + cooldown approach in the PM doc. I can own implementing dedupe + a 5m cooldown window. ETA: EOD Wed. @sanjay assigning to me. :white_check_mark:

alex: Quick suggestion for thresholds: trigger when 503-rate > 0.5% over 1m AND instantaneous spike > 3x baseline. Route to severity=P3 by default, escalate to P1 if sustained > 5m. Leaning on metrics vs single-event thresholds to reduce noise.

priya: Can we fingerprint by (service:route:replica) to avoid cross-service dupes? Also propose disabling paging for infra-only alerts (slack notifications only) unless a customer-impact tag is set.

sanjay: Good call on fingerprinting. Priya — can you update the runbook with the fingerprinting scheme and mark infra-only alerts as slack-only in the config? ETA Fri COB?

maya: Implementation note: plan to add dedupe config like:
```
alert_dedupe:
  window: 120s
  fingerprint: "service:route:replica"
  cooldown: 300s
```
I'll open a PR against infra-alerts repo and add unit tests for the hash function.

alex: When you open the PR, include a quick sim of noise reduction (10m of tail traffic) so we can quantify expected page reduction. Also list any edge-cases where cooldown might mask outage.

priya: Updated runbook draft here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/503-spike-dedup (added fingerprint section + paging rules). I'll also add a manual rollback step and a rollout plan (canary to 10% routes).

sanjay: Action items (assignments & deadlines):
- Maya: implement dedupe + cooldown, PR by Wed EOD (1767200000).
- Alex: finalize threshold numbers and add simulation results to PR review, ETA Thu.
- Priya: update runbook & paging policy, include canary rollout, ETA Fri COB.
- Sanjay: update paging policy doc and notify oncall rotation + product stakeholders, ETA Fri.

oncall-bot: Note: any paging policy changes must be approved by oncall leads and recorded in /ops/paging-policies before rollout. Approval reminder sent to #eng-oncall-leads.

maya: Quick question — for the cooldown, do we want to suppress slack notifications entirely or post aggregated summary? I prefer aggregated summaries every cooldown window. :thought_balloon:

priya: Aggregated summaries please — put a single snapshot + top-3 affected routes. That keeps visibility without noise.

sanjay: Agreed. We'll do aggregated slack summaries at the end of the cooldown window.

alex: I'll prepare the sim and add a small notebook to the PR so reviewers can reproduce numbers.

sanjay: Great. Let's reconvene after PR reviews. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or escalate in #eng-oncall. Thanks all. :pray:
